provenance.method: Reviewed Translink accessibility guidance for bus and rail on 2026-09-05; operator-specific scope kept explicitly Northern Ireland/cross-border where stated.

name: Translink — accessibility and passenger assistance
description: Translink accessibility information covering passenger assistance, accessible bus/rail features and personalised journey advice.
intended_use: Inspect current Northern Ireland operator assistance and accessibility information before a Translink journey.
audience_or_context: Northern Ireland Translink bus and rail services, with specific cross-border arrangements where stated by Translink.
limitations: This is operator information, not an independent quality score.
Features vary by fleet, stop/station and service; check the current journey.
Translink arrangements must not be presented as Great Britain-wide rules.
cost_or_access_notes: Public operator information; booking/contact requirements may vary by assistance type.
conflicts_of_interest: Translink describes its own services and accessibility commitments; ND Oracle records scope and limitations without independently scoring delivery quality.
